content.comment_body: Thank you for your assistance! I had encountered the same issue and have resolved it. I have another question: is it possible to add a component of the 'link' type on the home page that directs to a different page within the same project? Thank you!
No, as far as I know, you can only add links to external pages.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wanted to improve navigation in a project using [product_name] [version_no] by adding an internal link on the home page. However, the product only allows link components to point to external URLs, demonstrating a limitation in creating internal navigation and reducing the flexibility of web projects built with this tool.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped to implement internal navigation within a web project by adding 'link' type components that connect different pages in the same project.
